STS2_WINE_FOX_ADDONS_RELIC_GOURMET_APRON: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Regen[/gold] for each food in your potion slots.
An apron steeped in the smell of good cooking. Wear it, and it feels like you could taste every dish in the world.
STS2_WINE_FOX_ADDONS_RELIC_EMERALD_BADGE: The villagers use these to remember who is worth haggling with.
WINE_FOX_REHEATED_AROMA_RUNE.title: Lingering Aftertaste
WINE_FOX_REHEATED_AROMA_RUNE.description: During combat, whenever you use a [gold]Food[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy and draw [blue]1[/blue] card. Triggers up to [blue]2[/blue] times each combat.
WINE_FOX_REHEATED_AROMA_RUNE.flavor: A good dish deserves a second warming. A fox will not even spare the aftertaste.
WINE_FOX_BASIC_CRAFT_INNATE_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Basic Crafting
WINE_FOX_BASIC_CRAFT_INNATE_RUNE.flavor: By the first hammer blow, both the materials and the plan are already in place.
WINE_FOX_INTERMITTENT_CHANTING_RUNE.flav: The chant crosses the gap, and no strength is lost along the way.
WINE_FOX_MYRIAD_DEPOT_RUNE.title: Myriad Depot
WINE_FOX_MYRIAD_DEPOT_RUNE.description: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]All-Item Warehouse[/gold] to your hand.
WINE_FOX_MYRIAD_DEPOT_RUNE.flavor: The shelves restock themselves; the fox only has to reach.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_BLAST_RUNE.title: Material Blast
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_BLAST_RUNE.description: At the end of your turn, deal [blue]1[/blue] damage to all enemies for each [gold]Material[/gold] you have.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_BLAST_RUNE.flavor: Even scraps have a temper. The more you hoard, the louder they roar.
WINE_FOX_MECHANICAL_SAW_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Mechanical Saw
WINE_FOX_MECHANICAL_SAW_RUNE.description: Your [gold]Mechanical Saw[/gold] consumes all your [gold]Stress[/gold] and deals [blue]7[/blue] additional damage for each Stress consumed.
WINE_FOX_MECHANICAL_SAW_RUNE.flavor: The blade bites into every scrap of Stress, then throws it all back out.
WINE_FOX_STONE_ARMOR_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Stone Armor
WINE_FOX_STONE_ARMOR_RUNE.description: Your [gold]Stone Armor[/gold] no longer makes you lose [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
WINE_FOX_STONE_ARMOR_RUNE.flavor: The stone shell no longer grinds away the fox's agility, leaving only its hard surface.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_SPARK_RUNE.title: Splinter Burst
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_SPARK_RUNE.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Material[/gold], deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_SPARK_RUNE.flavor: Even the smallest scraps can sting when they fly.
WINE_FOX_NETHERITE_CHESTPLATE_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Netherite Chestplate
WINE_FOX_NETHERITE_CHESTPLATE_RUNE.descr: Your [gold]Netherite Chestplate[/gold] triples the Block you gain from [gold]Plating[/gold] at the end of your turn.
WINE_FOX_NETHERITE_CHESTPLATE_RUNE.flavo: The thicker the plates, the steadier the fox.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_REFUND_RUNE.title: Reforged Scraps
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_REFUND_RUNE.descriptio: Whenever you spend [gold]Material[/gold], there is a [blue]50%[/blue] chance to refund the [gold]Material[/gold] spent.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_REFUND_RUNE.flavor: Unfinished material is not waste. It simply needs another turn at the forge.
WINE_FOX_WIRELESS_TERMINAL_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Wireless Terminal
WINE_FOX_WIRELESS_TERMINAL_RUNE.descript: Your [gold]Wireless Terminal[/gold] can be played for free.
WINE_FOX_WIRELESS_TERMINAL_RUNE.flavor: Full signal, no queue for materials.
WINE_FOX_TRAVELING_TROVE_RUNE.title: Traveling Trove
WINE_FOX_TRAVELING_TROVE_RUNE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Token[/gold] card to your hand.
WINE_FOX_TRAVELING_TROVE_RUNE.flavor: Every time the satchel opens, something unexpected tumbles out.
WINE_FOX_TOKEN_CARD_HOVER.title: Token Card
WINE_FOX_TOKEN_CARD_HOVER.description: Token cards are special cards generated by cards, relics, or powers. They usually do not enter your deck.
WINE_FOX_UPGRADE_RUNE.selectionFooter: When obtained, add 1 [gold]{CardName}[/gold] to your deck.
